sources.scientific_reference: User-supplied Chen et al. (2002) and Gross et al. (2013) articles.
sources.status: Pure-binder-only calibration to Chen Figure 4 model curves; not experimental measurements. AP and mixed-composition data are excluded from fitting.
sources.density_cp_conductivity: Density and conductivity fixed at original provisional constituent values. Only binder cp and decomposition heat are fitted; all AP properties remain fixed.
sources.kinetics: Chen Figures 5 and 6 pure-component Arrhenius endpoints. The generator converts physical speed prefactors to the phase-field normalization for each case.
sources.heat_release: Binder heat fitted to Chen t=0 endpoints; Gross -300 cal/g is no longer imposed. AP stays -100 cal/g. Heat is applied once during phase change with frozen chemistry.
sources.mixing: Supply unblended constituent values. The homogeneous phase-change model applies the requested mass/volume mixing rules once.
sources.temperature: Cold temperature 300 K retained from the original sweep.
sources.calibration: q=200 and 1000 cal/(cm2 s) fit binder cp/Q with rho=920, k=0.13, A=10.36, E/R=7500, T0=300 fixed. q=500 is held out. Simulation-based adjustments are resolution/surrogate dependent.
